verdict.rationale: Spline docs show multiple export paths that support portability outside the editor — code export to Vanilla JS/Three.js/React/Next.js/react-three-fiber, a self-hosted fully self-contained ZIP export, and a native <spline-viewer> web component — which let designs be used and tooled outside Spline's own editor. However, there is no evidence the native .spline project file format itself is open or documented (no schema, no OpenAPI/spec found, and a spec probe returned 404s), so the underlying source file remains a proprietary, closed format even though various exported artifacts are portable. Missing for 10: documentation of the .spline file format's internal schema/spec, and any independent confirmation that exported code/ZIP outputs are faithfully round-trippable back into the editor.
